title: The #Somos600M Project: Generating NLP resources that represent the diversity of the languages from LATAM, the Caribbean, and Spain

bias_targets.methodology: Establishing an open generative LLM leaderboard with native evaluation datasets across diverse Spanish dialects and co-official languages (such as Catalan and Euskera) to benchmark performance disparities and mitigate the English-centric bias of existing models.
Evaluating models' ability to detect and mitigate toxic language by generating counter-narratives in Basque and Spanish using the CONAN-EUS dataset.
Addressing gendered language and non-inclusive phrasing through the creation of the 'TraductorInclusivo' instruction dataset, designed to train models to rewrite text using inclusive language.
